lines.t: Streams of water flow down from the mountains
Springs of water burst forth from the rocks
Rivers of water overflow their banks
And still the thirst of this people is not quenched
Multitudes of dead and dying peoples
Fill the streets and the alleyways
No light breaks through the open spaces
As the darkness grows and is very thick
Many dark and dead of faces wandering about
The light of life dims as their hearts grow cold
For there is no hope in man
Has no place in man's designs
Departs from the hearts of the wicked
And perversion is praised and celebrated openly in the streets
As the innocent look upon them with wonder
